answer: Each liveness response includes a hash of the previous one, forming a chain that proves the client was continuously present. A gap in the chain — a missing link — means the client was absent or the responses were stitched together from different sessions, and the chain is verified on every request. A plume out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. A haven and a basalt may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
